title: 26.2 Bgm Backport
description: Let 1.21.x turn you into a 26.2 background music
body:
The suggested resource pack is quite straightforward. It ported the "Chaos Cube" music to the 1.21.x version of Minecraft. It's designed for Minecraft versions prior to 26.1. There's a random chance for it to play alongside the standard original music, including the title screen.  
include

- ebb - fingerspit
- home - fingerspit 
- memories - fingerspit 
- nightly - fingerspit 
- shores - fingerspit 

This resource pack also includes a language file, which is compatible with some music player mods that support this file, such as Simple Music Control.

---

这个资源包很简单，它将“Chaos Cube”音乐移植到了1.21.x版本的《我的世界》中。设计用于26.1版本以下的《我的世界》。有随机机会与标准原版音乐一起播放，包括标题画面。 
包含 

- ebb - fingerspit
- home - fingerspit 
- memories - fingerspit 
- nightly - fingerspit 
- shores - fingerspit 

此资源包还包含语言文件，适用于支持该文件的一些音乐播放器模组，如Simple Music Control。
